info.title: Workbox API
info.summary: Sandboxes for AI agents over REST and WebSocket.
info.description:
Create sandboxes, run commands and durable sessions in them, move files, follow events and manage keys and webhooks. This document is generated from the server's route table and request schemas.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation names the scope it needs in `x-workbox-scope` and its description; `admin` stands for every scope. Operations with `x-workbox-unbound-key` refuse a key bound to sandboxes. Operations with `x-websocket` are WebSocket upgrades. A request carrying `Origin` or `Sec-Fetch-Site`, or addressed to a Host the server does not serve, is refused with 403 before authentication.

JSON bodies are at most 8388608 bytes and are checked against the schemas here; string lengths count UTF-8 bytes. Send `x-request-id` to choose the request id that errors and logs carry.

servers.description: The server that serves this document; `workbox serve` listens on http://127.0.0.1:8790 by default.

bearer.description: A scoped API key: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Scopes are `read`, `exec`, `admin`, `answer`; `admin` stands for all of them.

queryToken.name: token
queryToken.description: The same token as a query parameter, accepted on WebSocket upgrades only.

details.description: Machine-readable detail, such as `{errors: [{path, message}]}` for a validation failure.

requestId.description: The request id, also in the `x-request-id` header; absent when a WebSocket upgrade is refused.

Error.description:
The error envelope. Each code answers with one status:

- 400: `E_PARSE`, `E_INVALID_PARAMS`
- 403: `E_DENIED`
- 404: `E_UNKNOWN_METHOD`, `E_NOT_FOUND`
- 409: `E_CONFLICT`, `E_BUSY`, `E_STATE`
- 413: `E_LINE_TOO_LONG`
- 416: `E_GAP`
- 423: `E_QUARANTINED`
- 429: `E_LIMIT`
- 499: `E_CANCELLED`
- 500: `E_INTERNAL`
- 501: `E_UNSUPPORTED`
- 503: `E_CLOSED`, `E_UNAVAILABLE`
- 504: `E_TIMEOUT`

A missing or invalid token is 401 `E_DENIED`, a body over the size cap 413 `E_LIMIT`, a route that exists under another method 405 `E_INVALID_PARAMS`, and an unknown path 404. The 5xx message of an error without a code is `internal error`.
